title: YELLOW. DESCENT.
metaDescription: Twin pear-cut fancy yellows, suspended by brilliant white — sunlight caught falling, twice over. 14.88 carats. By Bez Ambar, Los Angeles.
copy: Twin pear-cut fancy yellows, suspended by brilliant white — sunlight caught falling, twice over. At nearly 15 carats across two matched stones, the pear shape is the right choice for colour that wants to move. The brilliant white diamonds above serve as contrast anchors — their colourlessness makes the yellow appear more saturated by comparison, the way a white frame deepens a painting.

specs.label: Center Stones
specs.body: 2 matched pear-cut Fancy Yellow diamonds · 14.88 carats total · approximately 7.44 carats each · colour-matched pair.

specs.label: Setting
specs.body: Pear-cut fancy yellows suspended from brilliant white diamond surmount. Drop earring construction.

specs.label: Metal
specs.body: Available in platinum or 18K gold. Metal and post/clip configuration on request.

specs.label: More Details
specs.body: Designed and made in Los Angeles. Available by private appointment. Each piece inspected stone by stone before delivery.
